notes: UPNM offers 141 research fields for Master and PhD programs, and 8 coursework Master programs. Specific program details are available in the UPNM Postgraduate Prospectus 2022-2026.

fees.notes: UPNM Centre for Graduate Studies official international postgraduate fee structure (approved 28 Aug 2025): research-mode tuition per semester is faculty-dependent - Master RM2,400-RM7,200 and PhD RM3,000-RM8,010; total per semester including service/health/insurance/development fees is Master RM3,150-RM7,950 (first) and RM3,000-RM7,800 (subsequent), PhD RM3,750-RM8,760 (first) and RM3,600-RM8,610 (subsequent). A single figure is not published because rates differ by faculty. Source: https://cgs.upnm.edu.my/index.php/postgraduate-study/127-fee-structure (accessed 2026-09-18).
